Title: HTTP/2 support in Azure API Management

Body.Content:
HTTP/2 is a major revision of the HTTP protocol focused on performance and efficiency. Microsoft is working on enabling HTTP/2 support on the client-facing side of the gateway. Support on the back end-facing side will be added later and tracked in a separate roadmap entry. 

To vote and share your thoughts on this development, please see the HTTP/2 support in Azure API Management.
